title: The compiled `termal review-freeze-check` omits the Git clean/eol normalization limitation that Engram's schema-1 checker discloses
outcome: The compiled `termal review-freeze-check ROOT MANIFEST EXPECTED` discloses on stderr every coverage limitation of the freeze protocol it checks, matching that protocol's own checker. For Engram schema 1 that includes the Git clean/eol normalization limitation that scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs prints (NORMALIZATION_LIMITATION: "Review freeze limitation: tracked content follows Git clean/eol normalization; changes erased by that conversion are not detected (not raw-byte coverage)."), alongside the Windows untracked-mode/symlink limitation it already prints (src/review_freeze.rs:7, :39). TermAl's own freeze protocol states its normalization limitation the same way if it has the same property.
acceptance: The compiled `termal review-freeze-check` omits the Git clean/eol normalization limitation that Engram's schema-1 checker discloses is done
